Radiology Report
Date: 09/04/2026

MRI lumbar spine 09/04/2026: L3-L4 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.

Findings: Disc protrusion at L3-L4 noted, causing moderate narrowing of the right neural foramen. No evidence of central canal stenosis or significant left foraminal narrowing. Adjacent vertebral bodies show normal marrow signal. No acute fractures or marrow edema.

Impression: L3-L4 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root. No other significant abnormalities identified.
